caption:
The video captures five red cylindrical containers lined up on a pale tabletop, four of them burning with bright yellow-orange flames while the middle container remains unlit and shows only its frayed top. The flames continuously flicker, changing height, width, tilt, and shape, indicating a burning process rather than a single event. Behind the table, five men stand or crouch in front of a graffiti-covered wall.

The man on the far left holds both hands over his ears throughout, while the crouching men lean forward to watch the burning tops, one smiling despite the smoke and bright light. The standing man in the black shirt raises his hands from a clasped position near his chest toward his head, and the remaining men make only small postural shifts while largely holding their poses.

The tabletop, containers, and background wall hold the same positions across the views, with the framing staying consistent. This view captures a still-ongoing scene, with the four flames continuing their irregular burning, leaning, curling, and producing drifting smoke near the men, while the middle container stays unlit.
